Talia Benson: Heads up — we’re rolling out the first tranche of **Status Page Transparency Upgrades** this week: new incident update templates + a standardized oncall runbook for status page comms.

Talia Benson: TL;DR expectations
• **All Sev1+ incidents** must use the phase templates for status updates (Investigating / Identified / Monitoring / Resolved)
• Use the **new status page components** (Streaming / Embeddings / Rerank / Console + region-specific serving where applicable) — no more “API degraded” catch-all unless it’s truly broad
• Include a **next update time** in every external update (even if it’s “within 30 min”)

Talia Benson: Links
• Templates (copy/paste ready): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Incident+Communication+Templates
• Runbook (step-by-step): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Runbook+-+Status+Page+Update+Procedure
• Cadence guidance by severity: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Status+Page+Update+SLA+and+Cadence
• External comms approval policy (pls skim): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/External+Comms+Approval+Policy

Talia Benson: Training sessions (30 min) — pick one
• Tue 7/2 10:30–11:00 PT
• Thu 7/4 13:00–13:30 PT
Calendar invites are out. We’ll do a quick walkthrough + 2 mini scenarios (streaming-only failures + region-specific capacity).

Talia Benson: Also: the incident-bot changes are landing behind a feature flag. It will start prompting for (1) impacted components, (2) phase template snippet, (3) mitigation/customer actions, and (4) next update time. You can still edit before publish.

Talia Benson: If you’re on primary oncall next week, please attend one session (or watch the recording) + complete the 5-question quiz in #eng-oncall after.

Talia Benson: Questions / edge cases welcome in thread. :white_check_mark:

Sean Gallagher: +1. This is now a Reliability Program requirement. We’ve had too many support escalations on “what’s actually impacted?” — this should materially reduce that. If you’re unsure which component to pick, post draft in #incidents for a quick second set of eyes.

Rafael Mendes: Adding a concrete rule that helped us in pilot: if the issue is **streaming disconnects / keepalive timeouts** but non-streaming requests are fine, mark **Streaming = Degraded Performance** and do NOT mark “Hosted API” as a whole. (Unless we’re seeing broad 5xx/latency.)

Tomáš Novák: Runbook has example scenarios near the bottom (streaming-only, embeddings elevated latency, model-family issues, region pinning). If folks see gaps, tag me + Kira.

Kira Thompson: Also please use the language in templates for uncertainty (e.g., “We are still investigating” / “We believe X is the likely cause but are validating”). Avoid saying “root cause confirmed” unless we’re truly there.

Elliot Price: Docs side: we’re updating public “How to read our status page” to match these components + customer actions. If you see a template line that feels like a promise/commitment we shouldn’t make, ping me.

Christine Wong: FYI component names in status page UI are now consistent with the taxonomy doc. If you notice weird hierarchy/labeling (ex: “Capacity & Routing” vs internal scheduler), drop notes here and I’ll queue a tweak.

Dev Patel: Support request: please include the “customer actions” line when relevant (retry w/ backoff, fallback model, region pinning). It saves us a ton of back-and-forth in tickets.

Incident Bot: :information_source: Reminder: For Sev1+ incidents, use `/incident status-update` to generate a draft with phase template + next update time.

Talia Benson: One more note: post-incident summaries are part of this rollout too, but we’re starting with the status updates/runbook first. Summary SLA target for Sev1 is **within 3 business days** (we’ll share the summary template + workflow once the bot stub is enabled).

Sean Gallagher: If anyone hits a situation where Security should review wording (provider issue, potential vuln-like detail, customer-specific impact), follow the approval policy and pull in @Dr. Aisha Rahman / @Marcus Lin. Better to be slightly generic than overshare.

Rafael Mendes: Re: cadence — if we’re still investigating and don’t have new info, we still post the “still investigating, next update by <time>” update. Silence is worse than “no new findings yet.”

Tomáš Novák: Recording + quiz link will be posted after the first session. We’ll keep it lightweight.

Talia Benson: Thanks all. Please help reinforce with your teams: **Sev1+ = templates required** starting today. :thumbsup:
(reactions: Sean Gallagher added :thumbsup:; Dev Patel added :pray:; Christine Wong added :white_check_mark:)
